name: chrome-history-mcp
description: Query Chrome browsing history via SQL against a lock-safe snapshot.
long_description: Exposes your local Chrome browsing history to LLMs through a single read-only SQL tool. Uses SQLite's online backup API for lock-safe snapshots that work while Chrome is running, opens the snapshot read-only so the model can't mutate it, and caps results at 1000 rows. Useful for activity reconstruction, time-tracking backfill, and 'what did I research last week' workflows.
